item.text: I’ll inspect the Eta template and source comments to determine the exact input format and any point-per-file/chunking constraints, then I’ll generate the input files and `outcome.json` without building or running EXCLURAD.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd; rg --files eta | sort; echo '--- template ---'; sed -n '1,240p' eta/input.dat; echo '--- README ---'; sed -n '1,220p' eta/README.md; echo '--- relevant source/input references ---'; rg -n -i \"input|phi|theta|W|Q2|chunk|point|npoint|npt|maximum|array\" eta/exclurad.F eta/fint.F eta/*.inc | head -240"
